"""Add a final 'Thank you for your attention' slide to a .pptx file, in place.

Pure-stdlib implementation: reads the pptx zip, byte-precise inserts into
presentation.xml / presentation.xml.rels / [Content_Types].xml / app.xml,
adds a new slide part + its .rels, rebuilds the zip, verifies, and unpacks
the result into q4_work/ for schema validation.
"""

import os
import re
import shutil
import sys
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

TEXT = "Thank you for your attention"

P_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main"
R_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"
REL_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"
SLIDE_CT = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"


def esc(s):
    return s.replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">")

    if not os.path.exists(target):
        sys.exit(f"Error: {target} not found")

    backup = target.replace(".pptx", ".original.pptx")
    if os.path.exists(backup):
        src = open(backup, "rb").read()
        print(f"Source: pristine backup {backup} (retry-safe)")
    else:
        src = open(target, "rb").read()
        with open(backup, "wb") as f:
            f.write(src)
        print(f"Pristine original saved to {backup}")

    zin = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(src))
    entries = {n: zin.read(n) for n in zin.namelist()}

    # ---- Inspect current structure -------------------------------------
    slides = sorted(
        int(m.group(1))
        for n in entries
        if (m := re.match(r"ppt/slides/slide(\d+)\.xml$", n))
    )
    if not slides:
        sys.exit("Error: no slides found in presentation")
    old_count = len(slides)
    new_num = max(slides) + 1
    new_slide_path = f"ppt/slides/slide{new_num}.xml"
    new_rel_path = f"ppt/slides/_rels/slide{new_num}.xml.rels"
    print(f"Existing slides: {old_count} (max slide{max(slides)}); adding slide{new_num}")

    pres = entries["ppt/presentation.xml"]
    pres_rels = entries["ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"]
    ct = entries["[Content_Types].xml"]

    # Slide size (EMU) for centering
    szm = re.search(rb"<[^>]*sldSz[^>]*>", pres)
    cx = int(re.search(rb'cx="(\d+)"', szm.group(0)).group(1))
    cy = int(re.search(rb'cy="(\d+)"', szm.group(0)).group(1))

    # New sldId id (unique, >255 by convention)
    sid_list = [int(x) for x in re.findall(rb"sldId[^>]*\sid=\"(\d+)\"", pres)]

    rid_set = set(re.findall(rb'Id="([^"]+)"', pres_rels))
    nums = [int(x[3:]) for x in rid_set if re.fullmatch(r"rId\d+", x)]
    new_rid = "rId" + str((max(nums) + 1) if nums else 1)
    while new_rid in rid_set:
        new_rid = "rId" + str(int(new_rid[3:]) + 1)
    rid_target = dict(re.findall(rb'Id="(rId\d+)"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"', pres_rels))

    # Last slide (by presentation order) -> reuse its layout for the new slide
    lst = re.search(rb"<([A-Za-z0-9_]+):sldIdLst>.*?</\1:sldIdLst>", pres, re.S)
    if not lst:
        sys.exit("Error: could not locate p:sldIdLst in presentation.xml")
    order_rids = re.findall(rb'r:id="(rId\d+)"', lst.group(0))
    last_rid = order_rids[-1]
    last_slide_name = rid_target.get(last_rid, "")
    last_num = int(re.search(r"(\d+)", last_slide_name).group(1)) if last_slide_name else max(slides)
    layout_target, layout_type = None, R_NS + "/slideLayout"
    lrels_name = f"ppt/slides/_rels/slide{last_num}.xml.rels"
    if lrels_name in entries:
        lm = re.search(
            rb'Type="([^"]*slideLayout[^"]*)"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"',
            entries[lrels_name],
        )
        if lm:
            layout_type, layout_target = lm.group(1).decode(), lm.group(2).decode()
    if not layout_target:  # fallback: first layout in package
        layouts = sorted(
            n for n in entries if re.match(r"ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout\d+\.xml$", n)
        )
        if not layouts:
            sys.exit("Error: no slide layouts available")
        layout_target = "../" + layouts[0].removeprefix("ppt/")
    print(f"New slide layout: {layout_target}")

    # Theme color + font (best effort, matches deck styling)
    theme = next(
        (entries[k] for k in entries if re.match(r"ppt/theme/theme\d+\.xml$", k)), b""
    )
    col = re.search(rb"<a:dk2>.*?<a:srgbClr val=\"([0-9A-Fa-f]{6})\"", theme, re.S) or \
          re.search(rb"<a:dk1>.*?<a:srgbClr val=\"([0-9A-Fa-f]{6})\"", theme, re.S)
    color = col.group(1).decode() if col else "1F3864"
    fon = re.search(rb"<a:majorFont>.*?<a:latin typeface=\"([^\"]+)\"", theme, re.S)
    typeface = fon.group(1).decode() if fon else "Arial"
    print(f"Theme color: #{color}, typeface: {typeface}")

    bx = (cx - bw) // 2
    bh = int(cy * 0.22)
    by = int(cy * 0.39)
    sz = max(2800, min(5400, round(cy / 6858000 * 4400)))
    slide_xml = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
        f'<p:sld xmlns:a="{A_NS}" xmlns:p="{P_NS}">\n'
        "  <p:cSld>\n"
        "    <p:spTree>\n"
        "      <p:nvGrpSpPr>\n"
        '        <p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/>\n'
        "        <p:cNvGrpSpPr/>\n"
        "        <p:nvPr/>\n"
        "      </p:nvGrpSpPr>\n"
        "      <p:grpSpPr>\n"
        "        <a:xfrm>\n"
        '          <a:off x="0" y="0"/>\n'
        '          <a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/>\n'
        '          <a:chOff x="0" y="0"/>\n'
        '          <a:chExt cx="0" cy="0"/>\n'
        "        </a:xfrm>\n"
        "      </p:grpSpPr>\n"
        "      <p:sp>\n"
        "        <p:nvSpPr>\n"
        '          <p:cNvPr id="2" name="ThankYouText"/>\n'
        '          <p:cNvSpPr txBox="1"/>\n'
        "          <p:nvPr/>\n"
        "        </p:nvSpPr>\n"
        "        <p:spPr>\n"
        "          <a:xfrm>\n"
        f'            <a:off x="{bx}" y="{by}"/>\n'
        f'            <a:ext cx="{bw}" cy="{bh}"/>\n'
        "          </a:xfrm>\n"
        '          <a:prstGeom prst="rect">\n'
        "            <a:avLst/>\n"
        "          </a:prstGeom>\n"
        "        </p:spPr>\n"
        "        <p:txBody>\n"
        '          <a:bodyPr wrap="square" anchor="ctr">\n'
        "            <a:normAutofit/>\n"
        "          </a:bodyPr>\n"
        "          <a:lstStyle/>\n"
        "          <a:p>\n"
        '            <a:pPr algn="ctr"/>\n'
        "            <a:r>\n"
        f'              <a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="{sz}" b="1" dirty="0">\n'
        "                <a:solidFill>\n"
        f'                  <a:srgbClr val="{color}"/>\n'
        "                </a:solidFill>\n"
        f'                <a:latin typeface="{esc(typeface)}"/>\n'
        "              </a:rPr>\n"
        f'              <a:t xml:space="preserve">{esc(TEXT)}</a:t>\n'
        "            </a:r>\n"
        f'            <a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="{sz}" dirty="0"/>\n'
        "          </a:p>\n"
        "        </p:txBody>\n"
        "      </p:sp>\n"
        "    </p:spTree>\n"
        "  </p:cSld>\n"
        "  <p:clrMapOvr>\n"
        "    <a:masterClrMapping/>\n"
        "  </p:clrMapOvr>\n"
        "</p:sld>\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")

    # New slide relationships (single slideLayout reference)
    new_rels = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
        f'<Relationships xmlns="{REL_NS}">'
        f'<Relationship Id="rId1" Type="{layout_type}" Target="{layout_target}"/>'
        "</Relationships>"
    ).encode("utf-8")

    # ---- Byte-precise inserts into existing parts -----------------------
    m_close = re.search(rb"</([A-Za-z0-9_]+):sldIdLst>", pres) or re.search(
        rb"</sldIdLst>", pres
    )
    if not m_close:
        sys.exit("Error: sldIdLst closing tag not found")
    prefix = (m_close.group(1).decode() + ":") if m_close.lastindex else ""
    new_sld_id = f'<{prefix}sldId id="{new_sid}" r:id="{new_rid}"/>'
    pres = pres.replace(m_close.group(0), new_sld_id.encode() + m_close.group(0), 1)

    new_rel = (
        f'<Relationship Id="{new_rid}" '
        f'Type="{R_NS}/slide" Target="slides/slide{new_num}.xml"/>'
    )
    if b"</Relationships>" not in pres_rels:
        sys.exit("Error: presentation rels closing tag not found")
    pres_rels = pres_rels.replace(b"</Relationships>", new_rel.encode() + b"</Relationships>", 1)

    override = (
        f'<Override PartName="/{new_slide_path}" ContentType="{SLIDE_CT}"/>'
    )
    if b"</Types>" not in ct:
        sys.exit("Error: [Content_Types].xml closing tag not found")
    ct = ct.replace(b"</Types>", override.encode() + b"</Types>", 1)

    app_edited = False
    if "docProps/app.xml" in entries:
        app = entries["docProps/app.xml"]
        am = re.search(rb"(<Slides>)(\d+)(</Slides>)", app)
        if am:
            app = (
                app[: am.start(2)]
                + str(int(am.group(2)) + 1).encode()
                + app[am.end(2):]
            )
            entries["docProps/app.xml"] = app
            app_edited = True

    # ---- Rebuild the zip ------------------------------------------------
    changed = {
        "ppt/presentation.xml": pres,
        "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels": pres_rels,
        "[Content_Types].xml": ct,
    }
    tmp = target + ".tmp"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w") as zout:
        for item in zin.infolist():
            data = changed.get(item.filename, entries.get(item.filename))
            if data is not None:
                zout.writestr(item, data)
        zout.writestr(zipfile.ZipInfo(new_slide_path), slide_xml)
        zout.writestr(zipfile.ZipInfo(new_rel_path), new_rels)
    zin.close()
    os.replace(tmp, target)

    # ---- Verify ----------------------------------------------------------
    with zipfile.ZipFile(target) as zc:
        names = set(zc.namelist())
        assert new_slide_path in names, "new slide missing"
        assert new_rel_path in names, "new slide rels missing"
        new_pres = zc.read("ppt/presentation.xml")
        new_ct = zc.read("[Content_Types].xml")
        new_pres_rels = zc.read("ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels")
        new_slide = zc.read(new_slide_path)
    ET.fromstring(new_pres)
    ET.fromstring(new_ct)
    ET.fromstring(new_pres_rels)
    ET.fromstring(new_slide)
    sids_after = re.findall(rb"sldId[^>]*\sid=\"(\d+)\"", new_pres)
    assert len(sids_after) == old_count + 1, "sldId count mismatch"
    assert str(new_sid).encode() in sids_after, "new sldId not registered"
    assert f'Id="{new_rid}"'.encode() in new_pres_rels, "new relationship missing"
    assert override.encode() in new_ct, "content-type override missing"
    assert TEXT.encode() in new_slide, "thank-you text missing in new slide"
    if app_edited:
        assert str(old_count + 1).encode() in zc.read(
            "docProps/app.xml"
        ), "app.xml slide count not updated"
    print("Verification: PASSED (xml parses, sldIdLst, rels, content types, text all consistent)")

    # ---- Unpack for schema validation -----------------------------------
    shutil.rmtree("q4_work", ignore_errors=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(target) as zc:
        zc.extractall("q4_work")
    print(f"Unpacked final file to q4_work/ for validation")
    print(f"Done: {target} now has {old_count + 1} slides; slide{new_num} = '{TEXT}'")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        int(m.group(1))
        for n in entries
        if (m := re.match(r"ppt/slides/slide(\d+)\.xml$", n))
    )
    if not slides:
        sys.exit("Error: no slides found in presentation")
    old_count = len(slides)
    new_num = max(slides) + 1
    new_slide_path = f"ppt/slides/slide{new_num}.xml"
    new_rel_path = f"ppt/slides/_rels/slide{new_num}.xml.rels"
    print(f"Existing slides: {old_count} (max slide{max(slides)}); adding slide{new_num}")

    pres = entries["ppt/presentation.xml"]
    pres_rels = entries["ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"]
    ct = entries["[Content_Types].xml"]

    # Slide size (EMU) for centering
    szm = re.search(rb"<[^>]*sldSz[^>]*>", pres)
    cx = int(re.search(rb'cx="(\d+)"', szm.group(0)).group(1))
    cy = int(re.search(rb'cy="(\d+)"', szm.group(0)).group(1))

    # New sldId id (unique, >255 by convention)
    sid_list = [int(x) for x in re.findall(rb"sldId[^>]*\sid=\"(\d+)\"", pres)]
    new_sid = (max(sid_list) + 1) if sid_list else 256

    # New relationship id (unique in presentation rels)
    rid_set = set(re.findall(rb'Id="([^"]+)"', pres_rels))
    nums = [int(x[3:]) for x in rid_set if re.fullmatch(rb"rId\d+", x)]
    new_rid = "rId" + str((max(nums) + 1) if nums else 1)
    while new_rid.encode() in rid_set:
        new_rid = "rId" + str(int(new_rid[3:]) + 1)

    # ---- Choose a placeholder-free (Blank) layout ----------------------
    layouts = sorted(
        n for n in entries if re.match(r"ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout\d+\.xml$", n)
    )
    layout_target = None
    for ln in layouts:
        data = entries[ln]
        if b'name="Blank"' in data or b'type="blank"' in data:
            layout_target = "../" + ln.removeprefix("ppt/")
            break
    if not layout_target:
        sys.exit("Error: no Blank slide layout found in package")
    layout_type = R_NS + "/slideLayout"
    print(f"New slide layout: {layout_target} (Blank)")

    # ---- Theme color + font (best effort, matches deck styling) --------
    theme = next(
        (entries[k] for k in entries if re.match(r"ppt/theme/theme\d+\.xml$", k)), b""
    )
    dk1 = re.search(rb"<a:dk1>.*?<a:srgbClr val=\"([0-9A-Fa-f]{6})\"", theme, re.S)
    dk2 = re.search(rb"<a:dk2>.*?<a:srgbClr val=\"([0-9A-Fa-f]{6})\"", theme, re.S)
    candidates = [m.group(1).decode() for m in (dk1, dk2) if m]
    color = min(candidates, key=lum) if candidates else "1F3864"
    fon = re.search(rb"<a:majorFont>.*?<a:latin typeface=\"([^\"]+)\"", theme, re.S)
    typeface = fon.group(1).decode() if fon else "Arial"
    print(f"Text color: #{color} (darkest of theme dk1/dk2), typeface: {typeface}")

    # ---- Build new slide XML --------------------------------------------
    bw = int(cx * 0.86)
    bx = (cx - bw) // 2
    bh = int(cy * 0.22)
    by = int(cy * 0.39)
    sz = max(2800, min(5400, round(cy / 6858000 * 4400)))
    slide_xml = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
        f'<p:sld xmlns:a="{A_NS}" xmlns:p="{P_NS}" showMasterSp="1" showMasterPhAnim="1">\n'
        "  <p:cSld>\n"
        "    <p:spTree>\n"
        "      <p:nvGrpSpPr>\n"
        '        <p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/>\n'
        "        <p:cNvGrpSpPr/>\n"
        "        <p:nvPr/>\n"
        "      </p:nvGrpSpPr>\n"
        "      <p:grpSpPr>\n"
        "        <a:xfrm>\n"
        '          <a:off x="0" y="0"/>\n'
        '          <a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/>\n'
        '          <a:chOff x="0" y="0"/>\n'
        '          <a:chExt cx="0" cy="0"/>\n'
        "        </a:xfrm>\n"
        "      </p:grpSpPr>\n"
        "      <p:sp>\n"
        "        <p:nvSpPr>\n"
        '          <p:cNvPr id="2" name="ThankYouText"/>\n'
        '          <p:cNvSpPr txBox="1"/>\n'
        "          <p:nvPr/>\n"
        "        </p:nvSpPr>\n"
        "        <p:spPr>\n"
        "          <a:xfrm>\n"
        f'            <a:off x="{bx}" y="{by}"/>\n'
        f'            <a:ext cx="{bw}" cy="{bh}"/>\n'
        "          </a:xfrm>\n"
        '          <a:prstGeom prst="rect">\n'
        "            <a:avLst/>\n"
        "          </a:prstGeom>\n"
        "        </p:spPr>\n"
        "        <p:txBody>\n"
        '          <a:bodyPr wrap="square" anchor="ctr">\n'
        "            <a:normAutofit/>\n"
        "          </a:bodyPr>\n"
        "          <a:lstStyle/>\n"
        "          <a:p>\n"
        '            <a:pPr algn="ctr"/>\n'
        "            <a:r>\n"
        f'              <a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="{sz}" b="1" dirty="0">\n'
        "                <a:solidFill>\n"
        f'                  <a:srgbClr val="{color}"/>\n'
        "                </a:solidFill>\n"
        f'                <a:latin typeface="{esc(typeface)}"/>\n'
        "              </a:rPr>\n"
        f'              <a:t xml:space="preserve">{esc(TEXT)}</a:t>\n'
        "            </a:r>\n"
        f'            <a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="{sz}" dirty="0"/>\n'
        "          </a:p>\n"
        "        </p:txBody>\n"
        "      </p:sp>\n"
        "    </p:spTree>\n"
        "  </p:cSld>\n"
        "  <p:clrMapOvr>\n"
        "    <a:masterClrMapping/>\n"
        "  </p:clrMapOvr>\n"
        "</p:sld>\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")

    # New slide relationships (single slideLayout reference)
    new_rels = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
        f'<Relationships xmlns="{REL_NS}">'
        f'<Relationship Id="rId1" Type="{layout_type}" Target="{layout_target}"/>'
        "</Relationships>"
    ).encode("utf-8")

    # ---- Byte-precise inserts into existing parts -----------------------
    m_close = re.search(rb"</([A-Za-z0-9_]+):sldIdLst>", pres) or re.search(
        rb"</sldIdLst>", pres
    )
    if not m_close:
        sys.exit("Error: sldIdLst closing tag not found")
    prefix = (m_close.group(1).decode() + ":") if m_close.lastindex else ""
    new_sld_id = f'<{prefix}sldId id="{new_sid}" r:id="{new_rid}"/>'
    pres = pres.replace(m_close.group(0), new_sld_id.encode() + m_close.group(0), 1)

    new_rel = (
        f'<Relationship Id="{new_rid}" '
        f'Type="{R_NS}/slide" Target="slides/slide{new_num}.xml"/>'
    )
    if b"</Relationships>" not in pres_rels:
        sys.exit("Error: presentation rels closing tag not found")
    pres_rels = pres_rels.replace(b"</Relationships>", new_rel.encode() + b"</Relationships>", 1)

    override = (
        f'<Override PartName="/{new_slide_path}" ContentType="{SLIDE_CT}"/>'
    )
    if b"</Types>" not in ct:
        sys.exit("Error: [Content_Types].xml closing tag not found")
    ct = ct.replace(b"</Types>", override.encode() + b"</Types>", 1)

    app_edited = False
    if "docProps/app.xml" in entries:
        app = entries["docProps/app.xml"]
        am = re.search(rb"(<Slides>)(\d+)(</Slides>)", app)
        if am:
            app = (
                app[: am.start(2)]
                + str(int(am.group(2)) + 1).encode()
                + app[am.end(2):]
            )
            entries["docProps/app.xml"] = app
            app_edited = True

    # ---- Rebuild the zip ------------------------------------------------
    changed = {
        "ppt/presentation.xml": pres,
        "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels": pres_rels,
        "[Content_Types].xml": ct,
    }
    tmp = target + ".tmp"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w") as zout:
        for item in zin.infolist():
            data = changed.get(item.filename, entries.get(item.filename))
            if data is not None:
                zout.writestr(item, data)
        zout.writestr(zipfile.ZipInfo(new_slide_path), slide_xml)
        zout.writestr(zipfile.ZipInfo(new_rel_path), new_rels)
    zin.close()
    os.replace(tmp, target)

    # ---- Verify ----------------------------------------------------------
    with zipfile.ZipFile(target) as zc:
        names = set(zc.namelist())
        assert new_slide_path in names, "new slide missing"
        assert new_rel_path in names, "new slide rels missing"
        new_pres = zc.read("ppt/presentation.xml")
        new_ct = zc.read("[Content_Types].xml")
        new_pres_rels = zc.read("ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels")
        new_slide = zc.read(new_slide_path)
        new_app = zc.read("docProps/app.xml") if app_edited else None
    ET.fromstring(new_pres)
    ET.fromstring(new_ct)
    ET.fromstring(new_pres_rels)
    ET.fromstring(new_slide)
    sids_after = re.findall(rb"sldId[^>]*\sid=\"(\d+)\"", new_pres)
    assert len(sids_after) == old_count + 1, "sldId count mismatch"
    assert str(new_sid).encode() in sids_after, "new sldId not registered"
    assert f'Id="{new_rid}"'.encode() in new_pres_rels, "new relationship missing"
    assert override.encode() in new_ct, "content-type override missing"
    assert TEXT.encode() in new_slide, "thank-you text missing in new slide"
    if new_app is not None:
        assert str(old_count + 1).encode() in new_app, "app.xml slide count not updated"
    print("Verification: PASSED (xml parses, sldIdLst, rels, content types, text all consistent)")

    # ---- Unpack for schema validation -----------------------------------
    shutil.rmtree("q4_work", ignore_errors=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(target) as zc:
        zc.extractall("q4_work")
    print("Unpacked final file to q4_work/ for validation")
    print(f"Done: {target} now has {old_count + 1} slides; slide{new_num} = '{TEXT}'")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
